description:
## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR A. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.12; no self-approval.

A verified webhook job enqueued before connector deactivation must re-check current connector state before payload/trigger processing. Owner Channels.JidoConnectBridge.fetch_webhook_config; reuse ChannelConfig.get/1 and its archive/1 lifecycle, local-only guard at job execution (not a new Action). Test first: disabled config cancels :connector_disabled, archived cancels :connector_archived, active still reaches payload validation. Paths: lib/zaq/channels/jido_connect_bridge.ex + test/zaq/channels/jido_connect_bridge_coverage_gaps_test.exs. No BO/UI, migrations or docs changes: existing channels service states queued jobs must recheck. Mock only existing external integration stubs. Validate isolated tests, mix q, stack as draft above #803. Broader data-source archive and watch scoping remain separate under zaq-emb.21/.22.
title: [zaq-emb.25] Cancel queued webhooks for disabled or archived data-source connectors
